results: Full H1 Sobolev duality proves that every complex continuous H1 functional is determined by ALL signed raw scalar modes. Consequently constant original even-frequency residual coefficients imply the ENTIRE native zero-trace H1 weak eigen-equation, not only a dense informal family of tests.

Every independent AC quasi-Hill state has BOTH scalar position and quasi-derivative in the FULL classical interval H1 class for arbitrary L2 Miura profile. Products of the L2 profile with the bounded actual state are L2. Neither endpoint periodicity of the quasi-derivative nor smoothness of the profile is assumed.

The complete original Miura residual coefficient formula is proved BEFORE any eigen-equation. The actual physical first-order rows imply its constant residual coefficient at EVERY frequency, retaining exactly the quasi-derivative endpoint jump. Full Sobolev duality then gives the entire native weak equation.

EVERY independent AC quasi-Hill Dirichlet state reconstructs a native zero-trace H1 eigenvector whose scalar position agrees at EVERY point of the original closed interval. A nonzero scalar state yields a NONZERO native vector; no boundary trace is imposed on its quasi-derivative.

For EVERY complex original unit-period H-minus-one source potential and EVERY complex energy, including ZERO, the independently normalized scalar Dirichlet characteristic vanishes IFF there is a nonzero native H1-to-H-minus-one weak eigenvector. The proof selects an actual shifted Miura chart and removes its constant shift. The same exact equivalence holds for the actual partial operator on the FULL H-minus-one base.

On the article ENTIRE original real mean-zero physically period-one H-minus-one distribution domain, the full original Dirichlet labels enumerate EXACTLY the native point eigenvalues of the actual partial operator. Every label has an actual nonzero native H1 eigenvector, and every native eigenvalue has the original positive-index label, including the complete central block. The entire smooth-test distribution is retained unchanged.

At EVERY complex original H-minus-one source potential and energy, all native eigenvectors are scalar multiples of any fixed nonzero eigenvector, by the verified AC IVP state classification. Every actual native domain eigenspace is finite dimensional and has dimension EXACTLY one at each characteristic zero, zero elsewhere. This is GEOMETRIC multiplicity, independent of analytic order.

Actual native finite root-chain spaces and their full union are constructed with the complete H1 domain at EVERY step, and identified EXACTLY with the actual H-minus-one partial operator's own domain chains. Domain eigenspaces and base-space first root levels are linearly equivalent via the injective native inclusion.

For native real singular potentials the actual Dirichlet form is Hermitian. Strictly positive native L2 energy excludes EVERY nonzero associated eigenvector. ALL actual finite root-chain levels and the full algebraic root space therefore collapse to the actual eigenspace, without an assumed resolvent or supplied spectral labels.

For EVERY real original unit-period H-minus-one source potential and EVERY complex energy, the FULL actual native algebraic root space is finite dimensional. Its dimension is one at every normalized characteristic zero and zero elsewhere, and equals the ENTIRE normalized analytic order. This includes zero and all central energies.

The real algebraic root-space identification is transported to the article ENTIRE unchanged original physical distribution domain. Each complete original Dirichlet label has actual algebraic root-space dimension ONE; the full positive-index label sequence counts EXACTLY these actual native algebraic root dimensions at EVERY complex energy.
